name: Wholesale Rend
description: Rend a large mass of gear or timber apart in one wide two-handed pull.

name: Undoing Hold
description: Hold a field of undoing over foes so their gathered qi comes loose as fast as it forms.

name: Structure Unmaking
description: Unmake the joins of every built structure in reach so that they sag and part.

name: Curse Annulment
description: Annul a heavy curse on an ally by unmaking its instance while leaving the principle behind it.

name: Wide Demolition
description: Demolish every work of hand across a broad front in one great pass.

name: Technique Annihilation
description: Destroy the construct of a cast technique so that it cannot re-form even if it would otherwise persist.

name: Wardruin Lance
description: Drive a lance of ruin through ward after ward and break each in turn.

name: Sundering Mantle
description: Wear a mantle that sunders every weapon and technique that touches it.

name: Existence Negation
description: Negate the being of a single target's body and take away what no guard can hold.

name: Landfall Ruin
description: Bring ruin down on a wide stretch of land so that all works of hand upon it fail.

name: Unmaking Dominion
description: Claim the field as a dominion where every foe's technique comes undone on being cast.

name: Grand Unmaking
description: The school's grand unmaking whose depth and reach follow the qi the master gives it.

name: Land Undoing
description: Undo every built thing across a vast stretch of land up to the destructive ceiling of a destruction master of this tier.

name: Total Rend
description: Rend a single target from edge to edge with a blow that stops at nothing short.

name: Nullity Hold
description: Hold a nullity about a foe that unmakes the instance of each technique he starts.

name: Unmaking Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of unmaking over a broad stretch and strip each work of hand to its parts.

name: Divine Unbinding
description: Unmake the knot of a deep divine curse on an ally while the principle behind it stands.

name: Annihilation Palm
description: Strike with a palm of pure annihilation that unmakes what it touches to the limit of reach.

name: Divine Annulment
description: Annul the force of every technique that enters the guard so none take effect.

name: Ward Annihilation
description: Annihilate a great ward from its heart outward until the whole of it falls.

name: Ruin Shroud
description: Draw a shroud of ruin about the body that unmakes whatever strikes it.

name: Divine Negation
description: Negate the life and the guard of a single foe together with a divine unmaking.

name: Cataclysm Edict
description: Decree a cataclysm over the field that unmakes all gathered qi and all works of hand.

name: Existence Sunder
description: Sunder the hold of one target on being and leave its guards without anything to hold.

name: Sovereign Ruin
description: The school's sovereign ruin whose breadth and weight follow the divine qi the master gives.

name: Unmaking Cataclysm
description: Unleash a cataclysm of unmaking over a whole region up to the destructive ceiling of a divine master.

name: Final Destruction
description: Destroy every instance of every work and technique in a vast circle up to the destructive ceiling of this tier.
